key_insight: OvAi Focus is an AI framework that combines ultrasound segmentation with morphology keyword extraction to make ovarian and adnexal mass interpretation more objective.
clinical_relevance: By standardizing how gynecological ultrasound findings are identified and described, it could support more consistent evaluation of ovarian structures and adnexal masses in precision oncology workflows.
method: Segmentation module identifies healthy ovaries plus solid and cystic components of adnexal masses.
Morphology module extracts IOTA-based keywords to describe adnexal mass features.
Outputs are compared against ground-truth masks and interobserver agreement metrics.
evidence_signal: In the abstract, segmentation achieved DICE scores from 0.62 for functional ovary to 0.87 for the whole adnexal mass, while morphology assessment showed Fleiss Kappa of 0.16 to 0.57 and Percent Agreement of 47% to 90%.
watch_item: Performance is promising but still uneven across structures and depends on validation against operator-labeled ground truth, so real-world robustness and generalizability need further confirmation.
paper_title: OvAi Focus: A framework for multiclass segmentation and morphological features extraction in gynecological ultrasound
